description.content: Endpoints related to payments. An SDP payment is an individual payment from an organization to a receiver. Each payment is part of a disbursement and occurs on the Stellar network. Granular payment status is stored in the SDP database and can be viewed in real-time on the SDP dashboard.

Returns all individual payments matching the request criteria. This endpoint supports pagination, and filtering on payment status, type, receiver ID, and timestamp. Each payment has details on the transaction itself, receiver, disbursement, asset, status history, and blockchain information.
